scope: Widened-head position channel: scaled additive QK logit contribution (1/sqrt(128)) of the 128-dim constant Q/K vectors under RoPE, summing all rotary pairs belonging to this axis (t 22, h 21, w 21 pairs); the 32-pair unrotated content channel is excluded. All 12 heads reported separately for each layer/step/branch. No token, prompt, step, head or branch averages. Delta is query minus key patch-grid position. Each table contains its own axis contribution; the total bias is the sum of all three axis tables. Initial constants pool all-token pre-RoPE post-RMSNorm means equally over 64 calibration prompts; trained constants come from the final EMA. Layer indices zero-based; denoising steps one-based.

q.scope: All 14400 layer/step/branch/head cells pooled (nothing exempt); all 128 coordinates per cell, Euclidean parameter-vector ratio of trained EMA minus calibration means over calibration means. No token averaging; each parameter is token-independent.

k.scope: All 14400 layer/step/branch/head cells pooled (nothing exempt); all 128 coordinates per cell, Euclidean parameter-vector ratio of trained EMA minus calibration means over calibration means. No token averaging; each parameter is token-independent.
